import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query 1: Get all air quality stations with metadata
stations_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type, area_type
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(stations_query, engine)
print(f"Total stations: {len(stations_df)}")
print(stations_df.to_string(index=False))

# Query 2: Get hourly PM2.5 readings for December 30, 2025 and compute daily averages
pm25_query = text("""
SELECT 
    station_id,
    AVG(pm2_5) as daily_avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as hourly_readings_count
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-12-30 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-12-31 00:00:00'
GROUP BY station_id
ORDER BY daily_avg_pm25 DESC
""")
pm25_daily_df = pd.read_sql(pm25_query, engine)
print(f"\nStations with PM2.5 data on Dec 30, 2025: {len(pm25_daily_df)}")
print(pm25_daily_df.to_string(index=False))

# Query 3: Join stations with PM2.5 data
combined_query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.id as station_id,
    aqs.name_en as station_name,
    aqs.station_type,
    aqs.area_type as zone,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as daily_avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as hourly_readings
FROM air_quality_station aqs
LEFT JOIN hourly_station_air_quality hsaq 
    ON aqs.id = hsaq.station_id
    AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-12-30 00:00:00'
    AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-12-31 00:00:00'
GROUP BY aqs.id, aqs.name_en, aqs.station_type, aqs.area_type
ORDER BY daily_avg_pm25 DESC NULLS LAST
""")
combined_df = pd.read_sql(combined_query, engine)
print(f"\nCombined station metadata and PM2.5 data: {len(combined_df)} rows")
print(combined_df.to_string(index=False))

# Stage WHO guideline
who_pm25_guideline = 15.0  # µg/m³ (24-hour guideline)
print(f"\nWHO 24-hour PM2.5 guideline: {who_pm25_guideline} µg/m³")

# Stage variables for synthesis agent
exceedance_stations = combined_df[combined_df['daily_avg_pm25'] > who_pm25_guideline]
exceedance_station_count = int(len(exceedance_stations))
worst_station_row = combined_df.dropna(subset=['daily_avg_pm25']).iloc[0]
worst_station_name = str(worst_station_row['station_name'])
worst_station_pm25 = round(float(worst_station_row['daily_avg_pm25']), 1)

print(f"Worst station: {worst_station_name}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

       AVG(pm2_5) as daily_avg_pm25,
       COUNT(*) as hourly_readings
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-12-30 00:00:00' 
  AND datetime < '2025-12-31 00:00:00'
GROUP BY station_id
HAVING AVG(pm2_5) > 15
ORDER BY daily_avg_pm25 DESC
""")
